run.method: isolated morphological matrix: true blends, compact forms, language stewardship
run.brief: Create a valid schema_version 1 identity portfolio for a pre-release Elixir/OTP library for declared, callable, measurable, optimizable LM programs, with a credible artifact horizon spanning instructions, demonstrations, tool descriptions, retrieval policies, playbooks, schemas, code fragments, and configuration. It is not an official DSPy port, static proof system, universal agent OS, provider SDK, guaranteed autonomous self-improvement system, safety product, standards body, or institute. Generate exactly 30 candidates: true blends, compact forms, and source-language stewardship; preserve all output and do not browse or availability-check.

candidates.grammar: Singular category noun; Modulect programs; Modulect-based.
candidates.rationale: It makes a program component sound selectable and inspectable, not autonomous, while extending to artifact-bearing modules.
candidates.etymology: Coined overlap blend: modu(le) + (se)lect, sharing the l boundary; no source-language claim.
known_concerns: It can be heard as modulate and selection may overstate optimizer breadth.
notes: form_mechanism: recoverable overlap-blend module/select, not compound, suffixation, or typo
code_projection: hex: modulect; otp: :modulect; module: Modulect; mix: mix modulect; config: :modulect; telemetry: [:modulect]
current_embodiment: declared modules, calls, metrics, and optimizer reports
horizon_embodiment: components carrying instructions, demonstrations, schemas, and configuration
